profile.summary: Evocom Berhad, through its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of flexible staffing and network support services for e-commerce and logistics activities in Malaysia, the People's Republic of China, and Hong Kong. The company's flexible staffing services engage in the provision of manpower supply services to support the logistics operations of e-commerce platforms. Its network support services relate to the provision of logistics support services including last-mile delivery, transhipment and parcel shipment services, such as door-to-door delivery services, third-party logistics services comprising air freight, courier and express mail services to facilitate the transportation of cargo, and parcel shipment services to retail customers. The company's customers comprising delivery contractors of e-commerce platforms. Evocom Berhad was founded in 2017 and is based in Semenyih, Malaysia.
profile.zh: Evocom Berhad 通过子公司为马来西亚、中国内地和香港的电商与物流活动提供灵活用工和网络支持服务，成立于2017年，总部位于马来西亚士毛月。
lines: 灵活用工服务：为电商平台的物流运营提供人力供应服务，客户为电商平台的配送承包商。
网络支持服务：提供物流支持服务，包括最后一公里配送、转运和包裹寄送，如门到门配送、空运/快递/特快专递等第三方物流服务，以及面向零售客户的包裹寄送服务。
lines_en: Flexible staffing services: provision of manpower supply services to support the logistics operations of e-commerce platforms, serving delivery contractors of e-commerce platforms.

Network support services: provision of logistics support services including last-mile delivery, transhipment and parcel shipment, such as door-to-door delivery, third-party logistics (air freight, courier and express mail), and parcel shipment services to retail customers.
